audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Jayce/Skill/Kennen/Kennen/Jayce/Kennen/Kennen while the prose concedes levels 1-5 to his range and calls level 6 the equalizer.
audit.why: Packet and mirror both read Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Jayce, Kennen on a 48.36% win rate. whys[1] ('he keeps the range lead at 2'), whys[2] ('out-trades your two-spell mark attempt'), whys[3] ('chip-and-respect'), whys[4] ('genuinely even') and whys[5] ('his edge by a hair') all match that, not the chart.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped as matched full/content pairs to Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Jayce, with phases[4].rating moved from 3/10 to 5/10 for the now-even level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Shock Blast' with no number, and no mention that Jayce's stance swap is itself on a timer.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6s — six ranks, and 16s at rank 1 is a genuinely long punishable window. Thundering Blow is 20/18/16/14/12/10s. The weapon swap is a flat 6s and its first attack in cannon form shreds Armor and Magic Resist, which is the burst tell. Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with the 16s Shock Blast, the 20s Thundering Blow and the 6s swap.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two stance errors repeated across five fields. The knockback is called 'cannon-stance E', and the poke is called 'Acceleration Gate Q'.
audit.why: Jayce's E is Thundering Blow in HAMMER stance (the knockback) and Acceleration Gate in CANNON stance (the speed gate). His Q is To the Skies! in hammer and Shock Blast in cannon. So the knockback requires him to swap to hammer — which costs him the 6s swap and drops his range — and the poke is Shock Blast fired through the gate, not a 'gate Q'. Written the current way, the reader watches the wrong stance for the disengage.
audit.corrected: whys[0], spikes[0].text, mid, late and wants.foe[1] now attribute Thundering Blow to hammer stance and name Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields claim Lightning Rush makes Kennen 'tankier mid-fight'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Lightning Rush is only 'morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it' — no resistances, no damage reduction, and the kit carries no shield flag. Any tankiness claim is unverified from the data available.
audit.corrected: Removed from late; recorded in unverified rather than asserted anywhere new.

edits.before: Jayce's Acceleration Gate Q out-ranges your Thundering Shuriken and bursts your squishy body before you have a stun — you can only farm at max range.
edits.after: Shock Blast fired through his Acceleration Gate out-ranges Thundering Shuriken and bursts your squishy body before you have a stun — farm at max range.

edits.before: Jayce owns the early range war — his Acceleration Gate Q outranges your Thundering Shuriken and chunks your squishy body before you can stack Mark of the Storm.
edits.after: Jayce owns the early range war — a gate-boosted Shock Blast outranges Thundering Shuriken and chunks your squishy body before you can stack Mark of the Storm.

edits.before: Use cannon-stance E knockback to break your Lightning Rush engage and reset to poke range
edits.after: Swap to hammer and Thundering Blow you off him, then gate back out to his poke range

edits.before: Level 6 is your one true equalizer — Slicing Maelstrom finally gives you a hard all-in his poke kit can't answer once you're on him. Bait his cannon-stance E knockback (it's his only disengage from your Lightning Rush), then E-in, W to accelerate the marks, and Flash-R to stun-lock inside the storm where his squishy ranged form melts. At first item (Hextech Alternator or Rocketbelt) that combo turns into a kill — this is your peak, so look for the all-in the moment his Q poke is down and his E is on cooldown. Outside of that window he still pokes you out, so don't trade autos in lane, trade with the full R commit.
edits.after: Level 6 is your one true equalizer — Slicing Maelstrom finally gives you a hard all-in his poke kit can't answer once you're on him. Bait Thundering Blow, his hammer-stance knockback and only real disengage, then E-in, W to accelerate the marks, and Flash-R to stun-lock inside the 550 storm where his ranged form melts. At first item (Hextech Alternator or Rocketbelt) that combo turns into a kill — go the moment his 16s Shock Blast is spent and Thundering Blow is down. Outside that window he pokes you out, so trade with the full R commit or not at all.

edits.before: This is your hardest stretch and the only place you reclaim ground — but only because Jayce is also a squishy poke champ, not because you out-scale him. Once your R is on cooldown he sits at hammer-cannon range and chunks you with gated Q before you can E onto him, and his E knockback keeps interrupting your engage. Your edge is that you're tankier mid-fight inside Lightning Rush and your AoE R wins any teamfight where you can flash onto him — so pivot to grouping and peeling rather than dueling him in the sidelane, and never face his poke down a wave without R up.
edits.after: This is your hardest stretch and the only place you reclaim ground — but only because Jayce is also a squishy poke champ, not because you out-scale him. Once your R is on cooldown he sits at cannon range and chunks you with gated Shock Blast before you can close, and a swap to hammer gives him Thundering Blow to shove you back off. Your edge is that Lightning Rush passes straight through his minions and your AoE R wins any teamfight where you can Flash onto him — so group and peel rather than dueling him in the sidelane, and never face his poke down a wave without R up.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, longer if he gates it. Step up the moment it is spent. - Thundering Blow (20s, hammer only): his knockback. - Your R: flat 120s, kill windows only.

notes: Stance attribution was wrong in five fields: Thundering Blow is hammer-stance E, Acceleration Gate is cannon-stance E, and the poke is Shock Blast fired through the gate rather than an 'Acceleration Gate Q'. The packet suspectName 'Use Lightning Rush' is a false positive. The 'Lightning Rush makes you tankier' claim is not supported by Riot's text or any kit flag; it was dropped from late and left unasserted elsewhere.
